name: Clockinator Lite
author: BeastThemes

sections.description:
Clockinator Lite is a powerful and easy-to-use employee and attendance management plugin for WordPress.
It helps you track working hours, manage staff, monitor shifts, and streamline HR processes.

With Clockinator Lite, you can:
– Track attendance and working hours in real time
– Manage departments, designations, and holidays
– Generate monthly attendance reports
– View employees past attendance history
– Enable employee dashboards on the frontend
– Notify admins when employees clock in/out
– Access an intuitive, translation-ready dashboard
– And many other features

Designed for businesses of all sizes, Clockinator Lite gives you the essential tools to manage your workforce directly inside WordPress.

🔑 Key Features (Lite Version)

  • User Management (Admin / Employee)
  • Attendance & Holiday Management
  • Real-time employee tracking
  • Monthly & past attendance reports
  • Admin notifications on clock in/out ( Email & SMS notifications )
  • Employee self-service frontend dashboard
  • Centralized admin dashboard
  • Clean UI & translation ready
  • And many other features

🚀 Upgrade to Pro

Unlock advanced HR features with Clockinator Pro, including:
– Shift, leave, payroll & reimbursement management
– Project & task management
– Payslip & Pauroll generation( partial & monthly wise )
– Exportable reports (CSV)
– Customizable email/SMS notifications
– Department & role-based access control
– More robust dashboards for HR Managers & Department Heads

A complete HR and attendance management plugin with clock-in/out, leave tracking, shift scheduling, and employee dashboards.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/clockinator-lite/ or install via WordPress Plugins menu.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Configure the settings under Clockinator Lite in the WordPress dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does Clockinator Lite support multiple roles?

Yes, you can manage both Admin and Employee roles.

Can employees view their own attendance?

Yes, the plugin provides a frontend dashboard for employees.

Is Clockinator Lite translation ready?

Yes, it supports translation for multilingual websites.

How is Clockinator Pro different?

The Pro version adds advanced features like payroll, leave requests, project management, and shift scheduling.
